note: A document or artefact a body-insurance (بیمه بدنه) claim file must contain. Regulation 53 names only generic 'مدارک مثبته' (Art. 10) and reports of 'مقامات ذی‌صلاح/انتظامی' (Art. 6); the per-peril document lists are insurer procedure. That distinction is recorded in source_class on every item, so a company checklist can never masquerade as regulation. `required_when` uses the same predicate language as the review questionnaire.

evidence.name: Completed loss declaration form
evidence.name_fa: فرم اعلام خسارت تکمیل‌شده
evidence.obtained_from: insurer claims office or the insured

evidence.name: Proof of an unavoidable cause preventing notice within five working days
evidence.name_fa: مدارک امور غیرقابل اجتناب تأخیر در اعلام
evidence.note: The regulation excuses non-compliance only for unavoidable causes; it does not use the phrase عذر موجه.

evidence.name: Policy copy with the declarations page, franchise schedule and private conditions
evidence.name_fa: بیمه‌نامه با برگه تعهدات، فرانشیز و شرایط خصوصی

evidence.name: Written proposal form as accepted by the insurer
evidence.name_fa: برگه پیشنهاد بیمه مصوب
evidence.note: The proposal is an integral part of the policy; anything the insurer rejected in writing is not an obligation. Accessories and their declared value come from here.

evidence.name: Premium receipt and instalment status at the event date
evidence.name_fa: رسید حق بیمه و وضعیت اقساط در تاریخ حادثه

evidence.name: Ownership documents and any transfer of title before the declaration
evidence.name_fa: اسناد مالکیت و انتقال سند پیش از اعلام خسارت
evidence.note: Where ownership transferred after an undeclared accident, the insurer owes nothing to the new owner.

evidence.name: Driving licence of the driver at the event, with class and validity
evidence.name_fa: گواهینامه راننده هنگام حادثه با صلاحیت و اعتبار
evidence.note: An expired licence is not the same as a void licence; the distinction is in the regulation text and must be captured, not inferred.

evidence.name: Assessment by the insurer-selected expert: damage scope, repairability, values
evidence.name_fa: گزارش کارشناس منتخب بیمه‌گر

evidence.name: Evidence of the transactional value on the accident date
evidence.name_fa: ارزش معاملاتی موضوع بیمه در روز حادثه
evidence.obtained_from: market price list, expert opinion, contemporaneous sales
evidence.note: This figure feeds both the 75% total-loss test and the underinsurance ratio, so it is the single most load-bearing assessed value.

evidence.name: Photographs of the damage and of the vehicle identification
evidence.name_fa: عکس خسارت و مشخصات خودرو
evidence.obtained_from: the insured or the inspection station
evidence.note: confidence_if_absent is an uncertified implementation ceiling, not a Regulation 53 rate. It caps a calculated result when this document is listed as absent.

evidence.name: Accident sketch and traffic authority opinion, including fault finding
evidence.name_fa: کروکی و نظر مقام انتظامی درباره تقصیر
evidence.note: Regulation 53 does not name this document; it is insurer practice. It is load-bearing for recourse and for the fault-based franchise reduction, which is also an insurer term.

evidence.name: Police station report of the theft, attempted theft or parts theft
evidence.name_fa: گزارش کلانتری

evidence.name: Criminal investigation file and the enquiry proving the vehicle has not been found
evidence.name_fa: پرونده آگاهی و استعلام عدم کشف
evidence.note: This is the artefact that fixes which date the sixty-day clock runs from; see U13.

evidence.name: Fire brigade report establishing the cause of the fire
evidence.name_fa: گزارش آتش‌نشانی درباره علت تامه حریق

evidence.name: Prosecution or court finding on intoxication, intent, flight or forged evidence
evidence.name_fa: نظر مرجع قضایی درباره مستی، عمد، فرار یا مدارک مجعول
evidence.note: Intoxication must be causally established by a competent authority; the insured's own statement or a suspicion is not a predicate the engine may apply.

evidence.name: Printed wording and schedule of each applicable endorsement
evidence.name_fa: متن و جدول الحاقیه‌های صادرشده
evidence.note: A token that an endorsement exists is not its economics. The engine refuses to guess rate, ceiling, covered causes or valuation base.

evidence.name: Registration transferred to the insurer before total theft settlement
evidence.name_fa: انتقال سند مالکیت به بیمه‌گر پیش از پرداخت سرقت کلی
evidence.note: Demanded only once the file says title has transferred. A pending clock or an explicit NOT_TRANSFERRED answer is the engine outcome, not a missing document.

evidence.name: Salvage valuation and either acceptance or the disagreement record
evidence.name_fa: تعیین ارزش بازیافتی و سوءتفاهم یا قبول آن
evidence.obtained_from: insurer, with the insured's position recorded
evidence.note: The valuation and the disposition decide whether salvage is subtracted or title transfers - never both.

evidence.name: Workshop labour and parts invoices or the repair estimate
evidence.name_fa: فاکتور یا برآورد تعمیرگاه
evidence.note: The regulation's basis is fair labour plus the current price of replaced parts; 'trusted workshop' is a network term, not a regulation term.

evidence.name: Insurer consent before the vehicle was moved or repaired
evidence.name_fa: موافقت بیمه‌گر پیش از جابجایی یا تعمیر

evidence.name: Identification of any other policy covering the same vehicle and risk
evidence.name_fa: سایر بیمه‌نامه‌های همان وسیله و خطر
evidence.note: confidence_if_absent is an uncertified implementation ceiling, not a Regulation 53 rate. It caps a calculated result when this document is listed as absent.

evidence.name: Award of the agreed arbitrator, arbitration board or court
evidence.name_fa: رأی داور مرضی‌الطرفین، هیئت داوری یا دادگاه
evidence.obtained_from: the insured or the court file
evidence.note: Article 22 is the dispute instrument of Regulation 53. There is no expert-board article in the regulation, so an 'official expert panel' outcome must be sourced to the contract or to Central Insurance complaint machinery.

evidence.name: Record of any change in risk, use or driver that was not notified
evidence.name_fa: سابقه تشدید خطر یا تغییر مصرف اعلام‌نشده
evidence.obtained_from: underwriting file and the insured's answers
evidence.note: Where the risk intensified, the regulation allows payment in the ratio of the premium charged to the premium appropriate to the intensified risk. That is a different mechanism from underinsurance and is not implemented in the calculation engine.

evidence.name: Claim history used by the franchise rule (prior losses in the policy year or term)
evidence.name_fa: سابقه خسارت‌های قبلی در سال یا دوره بیمه
evidence.note: First-loss and subsequent-loss franchise rates are insurer terms, and the multi-year counting rule changes which history applies.
